query: INSERT INTO notification_groups (account_id, category, revision, read_through, kind, source_revision, occurred_at) SELECT id, $2, 1, 0, $3, $4, $5 FROM users WHERE active = TRUE AND id <> $1 ON CONFLICT (account_id, category) DO UPDATE SET revision = notification_groups.revision + 1, kind = EXCLUDED.kind, source_revision = EXCLUDED.source_revision, occurred_at = EXCLUDED.occurred_at
